problems.environmentNote: Same on live (opportunities come from the live snapshot).
problems.title: Internship pages never say if it is paid, what the job is or who can apply; prep-crew features sit above the job facts
problems.summary: Both internship personas reached a details page (goal met) but could not tell pay, duties or eligibility ("Graduate Intern" for an undergrad?). "Do it with people / Start a prep crew" comes before the job facts.
problems.rootCauseHypothesis: Imported listings carry only title, place, field and a link; the page leads with social features instead of the facts students check first.

evidence.quote: I don't need a 'prep crew', I need to know if it pays. Why is that stuff
But nothing says if it's paid or what I'd actually do.
'Software Graduate Intern' — that's probably for grad students, I'm an undergrad. And still no pay anywhere.

problems.suggestedFix: Put a facts block first (Paid/Unpaid/Unknown, level: undergrad/grad, one-line summary) and move prep crews below; show "Pay: see posting" when unknown.

problems.environmentNote: Same on live (opportunities come from the live snapshot).
problems.title: Rides is not on Home or in onboarding; students find it only at the bottom of Social › Meetups
problems.summary: Diego (today) and Seoyeon (2026-11-03) both searched for rides; it sits under "More ways to meet". Once found, the Rides page worked very well.
problems.rootCauseHypothesis: Rides is filed as a social feature; Home tiles and onboarding goals never mention it.

evidence.quote: OK, where's rides? Events, opportunities, clubs, meetups... nothing says ride or carpool.
There it is — Rides. Buried at the bottom of Social > Meetups though.

problems.suggestedFix: Add a Rides tile on Home (at least around breaks) and mention rides in "Make campus life easier".

problems.title: On a plan, "Going" looks like a status, joins instantly and does not say others will see you
problems.summary: Aisha could not tell if "Going" was her status or the button, how it differs from "Interested", or whether the host is told; it joined without a confirm. Counts also disagreed ("1 going" vs "0 joined").
problems.rootCauseHypothesis: Same button label for state and action; list counts the host, detail does not.

evidence.quote: Wait, does 'Going' mean I'm already marked as going, or is it the button to say I'm going?
Oh — it just did it, no 'are you sure?'.

problems.suggestedFix: Label the action "Join lunch", say "Hana and others will see you joined", and count the host the same way in list and detail.

problems.title: "Fits your major" appears on unrelated internships (Civil Engineering → robotics; History → oil and gas)

evidence.quote: Says 'Fits your major (Civil Engineering)' on Electrical Engineer and Robotics interns. That's not civil.
